messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm kicking a targeted recompute for aggregates covering 2026-03-15 -> 2026-03-17 (48h). Console estimate looks fine but we hit the per-tenant backfill quota when claiming slices. Need quick call on routing/priority lane behavior so this doesn't stall.
Sam: On it. can we use the low-priority preemptible lane? should avoid stealing dedicated slots.
Maya: Prefer low-priority, yes. console currently sends `priority=tier:low` which maps to preemptible. but when slices are >1000 it still tries to claim reserved slots in EU.
Priya: That's what I was seeing yesterday. console API has a `claim_strategy` param we haven't surfaced in the UI. we can set `claim_strategy=preempt-only` for this run.
Taylor: API bikeshed: `claim_strategy` enum is inconsistent across services — we use `preempt-only`, `fallback-reserved`, and boolean `allow_reserved` in older endpoints. we should normalize.
Sam: Agree. quick fix: CLI workaround: `recompute run --from=2026-03-15 --to=2026-03-17 --priority low --claim preempt-only`. I tested dry-run: `recompute run --dry-run ...` returns 48h slices, est tokens: 3.2M, est cost $42.
Jonas: Two production concerns: 1) we need recompute traces to carry `recompute_run_id` in telemetry so downstream freshness queries can exclude in-flight runs. 2) metric docs need to note recompute tags so SLOs aren't skewed.
Maya: +1 on both. ops: can we have the job attach `recompute_run_id` to emitted events? even as `meta.recompute_id`?
Priya: We can add `meta.recompute_id` at the ingress side but older pipelines skip `meta` payload. would prefer `tags.recompute_id` to be consistent with logs.
Taylor: Can we avoid schema churn? I'd rather add `recompute_run_id` as a top-level optional field in the event envelope. small patch.
Sam: Implementation plan: add optional field at router enchantment, fall back to `tags.recompute_id` if present. codec-safe for older consumers.
Jonas: Also, console should mark the recompute run as `test` vs `production` in the UI to prevent accidental alerting. set `suppress_alerting=true` by default for console-triggered ad-hoc runs.
Maya: Good call. we'll flip `suppress_alerting` for this run. can someone update run metadata?
Priya: I'm updating the ticket and UI flag now. Will push a small change to the API: `suppress_alerts` default true for ad-hoc console flows.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for service `recompute-api` (sha: a1b2c3d).
Sam: OpsBot :thumbsup: keep an eye on claim failures. if we get >5% claim errors in 10m, fallback to `fallback-reserved` and throttle concurrency.
Maya: Noted. If fallback happens, throttle to 20 concurrent slices and tag run with `fallback_reason=claim_errors`.
Taylor: UX request: console should show a live claim success rate + a small suggestion banner: "Try preempt-only for tenant-scoped small batches". keeps PM happy.
Priya: I'll add a banner; also adding `dry-run` checkbox to show the console's estimate vs actual after run completes.
Jonas: Monitoring items: create a Grafana panel for `recompute_claim_success_rate{region,tenant}` and an alert for drop below 90% for 15m. Also a Prometheus label for `recompute_run_id`.
Maya: Ok team — I'm starting the run with `claim=preempt-only` and `suppress_alerts=true` now. will post logs if anything breaks.
Sam: Copy. I'll watch the router logs and preempt queue.
OpsBot: job-runner: backfill job 6123456789-01 created, slices=48, concurrency=40, claim_strategy=preempt-only.
Maya: Early status: 6/48 slices claimed, 0 failures so far. est completion ~1h10m.
Jonas: Saw one event without `recompute_run_id` — looks like older producer. opening a followup to patch the producer to pass envelope field.
Priya: Patch queued — will ship in next 2h.
Taylor: UX note — after run ends, console should surface "delta to estimate" as % and absolute tokens so PMs can calibrate.
Maya: Agreed. For this run: est tokens 3.2M, currently emitted 0.35M after 10m.
Sam: Numbers look healthy. I'm going to leave routing rules unchanged for now. if claim error rate spikes we'll flip fallback logic.
Maya: Thanks all. will update thread and ticket with final completion and delta. :party_parrot:
